annotations.title: Search open calls (recent awards as an aggregate)

description: Search the public consulting calls open now in Europe by keywords (title, buyer and winners; words match the start of words, accents ignored). Put the subject in query as 1 to 4 topic words (e.g. 'internal audit', 'stress testing'), not a sentence; put country, status, kind, min_value_eur and firm in their own fields, never in the words. query also matches buyer and winner names, so a buyer's name ('European Investment Bank') works as words. Search in English: every title is also indexed in an English translation; add words in the country's language only as extra variants. To explore a topic, put the variants (synonyms, the country's languages) in one call with queries[] instead of calling several times. Each search runs by words and by meaning: the words are also turned into a vector with bge-m3, the open embedding model the radar's board uses (no generative model), and rows close in meaning are added after the word matches; each row's found_by says words or meaning. Up to 3 searches of a call run by meaning (the ones with fewest word matches first). A search that finds 2 rows or fewer is widened automatically and says how in recall: synonyms and other languages, fewer words, the radar's subjects, then filters let go of one at a time (value, open only, kind, country); widened rows carry found_by and relaxed. With nothing at all, recall gives the nearest subjects and variants that do find rows, and coverage says when the request is outside the data (goods, works, jobs, grants, outside Europe). The awards of the last six months that match come only as an aggregate (awarded_past: how many, values, bids, frequent winners; no figures under a few awards), never row by row. Filter by status, country, kind of work, minimum value or winning firm. Each result has the public link to its notice, title (the notice's own) and title_en (machine translation), and a link to the same view in the radar; an open call also has its page on arquestra.dev (page: summary, bid checklist, weekly alert). Paged: up to 25 a page, 50 a query (50 merged rows for queries[]); each search run counts as one call against the daily caps. The result also carries search_by_meaning, the radar's search by meaning for the same words.

country.description: A country (ISO code or name), or several separated by commas: ESP,FRA. Europe only (EU and EEA, GBR, CHE, EUI for the EU institutions); a country outside Europe gets coverage: not covered.

expand.description: Also run the same words from a small built-in list of common consulting topic words (environment, audit, evaluation, training, mobility, health, energy, water, digital, legal, communication, procurement...): English synonyms over every title, and the country's languages (en, fr, nl, de, es, it) over the rows with no English title. Marked expanded in by_query; up to 16 searches in all. Default false.

firm.description: Only awards won by a firm whose name contains this.

kind.description: A kind of work, or a subtype: procurement_advisory (advising public buyers on their tenders), statutory_audit (audit of accounts), data_protection (data protection officer), hse_advisory (workplace health and safety advice).

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.

queries.description: Up to 8 searches in one call (synonyms, other languages' words, other countries, other firms: e.g. the awards of two firms and the open calls on a topic in one call): run together, rows merged without repeats, each row's matched lists the searches that found it (rows found by more come first), by_query gives each search's count, one panel. An item's filters replace the call's own; unset, the call's apply.

firm.description: Only awards won by a firm whose name contains this (one item per firm).

query.description: Words to find; may be empty when firm is given (that firm's awards, as an aggregate).

1 to 4 topic words in English (at least one word of 3 letters, or none with firm: that firm's recent awards, as an aggregate), e.g. 'credit risk', 'sustainability reporting'. All words must match; a search that finds 2 rows or fewer is widened (recall). Not a sentence, and no country, date or value in it: those have their own fields. Give query or queries.

status.description: Default any (open calls first). open: calls to bid for now; awarded: the last six months, as an aggregate only (awarded_past; no rows). With open and 2 rows or fewer, the recall adds awarded and recently closed rows, marked relaxed.

via.description: Leave this out. Set only by the radar's panel (MCP App) when the person uses its filters or 'show more' (panel), or by the site owner's own tests (dev), so that use is counted apart.
